proof_summary: Writing the ranks via \(f_n=\lfloor e^{H_n}\rfloor\), analytic bounds show \(1\le e^{H_{n+1}}-e^{H_n}<2\), so \(f_{n+1}-f_n\in\{1,2\}\) and hence every rank increment is \(2\) or \(3\).  The indicators then telescope to \(\#3=f_{N+1}-N-2\) and \(\#2=2N+2-f_{N+1}\); since \(f_{N+1}/(N+1)\to e^\gamma\), their ratio tends to \((e^\gamma-1)/(2-e^\gamma)\), which lies in \((3.5,3.6)\) from the explicit bounds \(16/9<e^\gamma<41/23\).
